[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1860 Camden marriage index names John Eldeit Glasgow and Mary Ann Lusted.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1780/records/1764828 Ancestry, Australia, Marriage Index, 1788–1950: John Eldeit Glasgow, record 1780/1764828].</ref>
The children's birth indexes cite the family across New South Wales: George Edward (1861, Tabulam), Charles H (1862, Tabulam), Lewis H (1866, Kingston), Alice (1868, Berrima), Alfred (1872, Richmond River) and Annie (1874, Richmond River).<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568697 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: George E Glasgow, record 1778/2568697].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568250 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Charles H Glasgow, record 1778/2568250].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568707 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Lewis H Glasgow, record 1778/2568707].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568245 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Alice Glasgow, record 1778/2568245].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568244 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Alfred Glasgow, record 1778/2568244].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568246 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Annie Glasgow, record 1778/2568246].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The 1860 Camden marriage index names Mary Ann Lusted and John Eldeit Glasgow. Birth indexes name Mary A or Mary Ann Glasgow and John E or John Eldeit Glasgow as parents of George Edward (1861, Tabulam), Charles H (1862, Tabulam), Lewis H (1866, Kingston), Alice (1868, Berrima), Alfred (1872, Richmond River) and Annie (1874, Richmond River). The shared names, New South Wales districts and chronology support one family; no single record proves every parent identity. No age, parents, occupation, death or later residence is held.
